bio.text: Mike Holcomb is serving his seventh term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 93, which includes portions of Jefferson, Cleveland, Lincoln and Drew counties.
He chairs the House Public Transportation Committee for the 95th General Assembly.

He attended Southern Baptist College, spent 28 years in public education as a teacher and administrator, and is a former Jefferson County Judge who previously served on the Jefferson County Quorum Court.
